40 -> 38: base's last three complexity offenders are gone, and the floor absorbs the +1 it was already red by.

    odoo/addons/base/models/ir_model_data.py           _module_data_uninstall  24 > 20  -> gone
    odoo/addons/base/models/ir_model_fields.py         write                   21 > 20  -> gone
    odoo/addons/base/models/ir_ui_view_name_manager.py check                   21 > 20  -> gone

None of the three was complex because the decision is complex. _module_data_uninstall
carried a recursive `delete` closure over three enclosing names AND the four-way
partition of ir.model.data rows AND the shared-prefetch teardown; ir.model.fields
`write` carried the whole manual-field validation loop -- state, model, ttype, the
one-rename-at-a-time rule -- inside the method that then performs the write; and
the view name manager's `check` was six independent loops over six unrelated maps
with nothing in common but the `view` they report to, which is why it comes out as
six one-purpose methods and a seven-line body.

The +1: c901 measured 41 against a floor of 40 at 0924e69ae67 and at every commit
this audit measured back to ad0c24c0623, so the gate has been red in the rising
direction longer than this branch. An exact ratchet cannot be moved halfway, so
that unit is absorbed here rather than left; it is not a fall this change earned.

only this change's fourteen files copied in.
